title: 僵尸进程与孤儿进程的成因与回收
expected_output:
场景A：子进程先于父退出，父未 wait
  child pid=501 state=Z(defunct)，占 pid 槽，等待父 wait()
  parent pid=500 仍运行但未 wait -> child 保持僵尸
  处理：parent 调用 wait() -> 回收 child 的 task_struct，pid=501 槽释放

场景B：父进程先于子退出
  oparent pid=502 退出 -> ochild pid=503 被 init(pid=1) 收养
  ochild.ppid 由 502 变为 1，照常运行，不是丢失

要点：僵尸占 pid 槽、kill -9 无效(已死)；孤儿被 init 收养、正常回收
code:
# 模拟僵尸进程与孤儿进程的成因与回收（确定性）
import itertools

class Proc:
    _pid = itertools.count(500)
    def __init__(self, name, ppid):
        self.pid = next(Proc._pid)
        self.name = name
        self.ppid = ppid
        self.state = "R"
        self.exit_code = None

procs = {}
def spawn(parent, name):
    p = Proc(name, parent.pid)
    procs[p.pid] = p
    return p

parent = Proc("parent", 1)
child = spawn(parent, "child")

print("场景A：子进程先于父退出，父未 wait")
child.state = "Z"
child.exit_code = 0
print(f"  child pid={child.pid} state=Z(defunct)，占 pid 槽，等待父 wait()")
print(f"  parent pid={parent.pid} 仍运行但未 wait -> child 保持僵尸")
print(f"  处理：parent 调用 wait() -> 回收 child 的 task_struct，pid={child.pid} 槽释放")
print()

orphan_parent = Proc("oparent", 1)
orphan_child = spawn(orphan_parent, "ochild")
orphan_parent.state = "X"   # 父已退出
orphan_child.ppid = 1      # 被 init 收养
print("场景B：父进程先于子退出")
print(f"  oparent pid={orphan_parent.pid} 退出 -> ochild pid={orphan_child.pid} 被 init(pid=1) 收养")
print(f"  ochild.ppid 由 {orphan_parent.pid} 变为 {orphan_child.ppid}，照常运行，不是丢失")
print()
print("要点：僵尸占 pid 槽、kill -9 无效(已死)；孤儿被 init 收养、正常回收")
